headline: Interactive Brokers Adds Brazilian Futures through Brazil’s B3 Exchange
summary: GREENWICH, Conn., August 05, 2026--Interactive Brokers announces eligible clients can now trade Brazilian futures in addition to equities through the B3 exchange.

headline: Interactive Brokers (IBKR) Stock Could Be 43% Above Fair Value Despite AI Connectivity News
summary: Interactive Brokers Group has delivered very strong share price gains over the last five years, yet both its intrinsic value estimate from the Excess Returns model and its market multiples currently point to the stock trading at a premium to those fundamentals. Interactive Brokers Group has returned about 471.1% over the last five years, which sets a very high bar for any further upside to be supported by the underlying valuation.
